JEnv for WindowsJEnv for Windows

用纯批处理按名字切换 JDKSwitching JDKs by name, in pure batch

一个 java.bat 垫片拦截 PATH 上的 java，把它转发到你选中的 JDK。同一个终端里，两个项目可以跑在两套 JDK 上；JAVA_HOME 永远指向 JEnv 目录，jenv use / jenv local 立刻对读环境变量的工具生效。A java.bat shim intercepts java on PATH and forwards it to the JDK you picked — two projects, two JDKs, one terminal. JAVA_HOME always points at the JEnv directory, so jenv use / jenv local take effect immediately for tools that read it.

技术栈Stack

  • Batch
  • Windows
  • Java
  • MCP

亮点Highlights

  1. 纯 cmd/batch 实现，不依赖 PowerShellPure cmd/batch implementation with no PowerShell dependency

  2. JAVA_HOME 恒指向 JEnv 目录，不再写死真实 JDK 路径JAVA_HOME always points at JEnv, never a hard-coded JDK path

  3. 三份纯文本注册表文件，取代 JSON 配置Three plain-text registry files instead of JSON

  4. 附带只读 MCP server，让 agent 查询当前 JDKA read-only MCP server so agents can query the active JDK
